critical_code_review_comments: MediaDivision.js line 94: <option>{k.kr_code} — {k.title} ({k.category})</option> — the Emergent visual-editor injects <span data-ve-dynamic='true'> wrappers around dynamic text expressions, which React flags as a hydration error ('In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'). This is a preview-tooling artifact rather than a user-facing bug (native <option> still renders text), but it produces a red console error. Consider hoisting the composed label into a variable (e.g. const label = `${k.kr_code} — ${k.title} (${k.category})`) so the injector treats it as a single expression and avoids the wrapper span inside <option>.

manufacture() (line 35) does not clear the previous result on new attempts until the request resolves — setResult(null) is called at the start (good). However selected.length===0 disables the button (good) but the 'Manufacture Everything' button (md-manufacture-all) has no confirmation modal despite running all 11 formats (~5+ minutes of LLM calls). Consider a confirm() or dialog before firing to prevent accidental Founder click.

Stat 'Products From Division' (stats.products_from_division) stayed at 1 after manufacturing 2 posters. This is correct (posters aren't products), but the label may confuse a Founder into thinking manufacture didn't work. Consider adding a separate 'Posters Rendered' or 'Assets Produced' metric so poster runs still show visible progress.

regenCover() only handles success/error toasts but doesn't refresh the result panel or product cover thumbnail after regen. If a cover is refreshed, the user has no in-place visual confirmation beyond the toast — consider re-fetching or animating the row.

BACKEND env var (line 12) is read at module top-level with no fallback. If REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is missing at build time, the concatenated download href becomes 'undefined/api/...'. Non-blocking today (env is set), but a runtime guard would be cleaner.

The initial useEffect (line 27–31) auto-selects ALL 11 formats (setSelected(r.data.catalog.map(c=>c.id))). Combined with md-manufacture-all this makes the 'default action' a very expensive multi-minute manufacture. Consider defaulting to only the two poster formats (the fast/deterministic path), so the fast happy-path is one click and the expensive path requires explicit action.
